translations.web: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.
translations.bsb: So again that night they got their father drunk with wine, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him; he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.
translations.kjv: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
translations.asv: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
